summary: Adds pkg/automation/engine, the automation engine on the workflow substrate: graph versions with layouts, Enable by a human only (code review digest, trigger read permissions, owner in trigger_owners), one outbox consumer (automations) that fans events out to enabled triggers and open waits with a cause depth limit, tenant schedules, manual starts and restarts, and the native runner of automation.run that keeps tokens, steps and waits in the new automation.* tables inside fenced transactions (parallel/join/foreach, event waits with timers, tasks and calls, conversation queues, retention). Publishes automation.run.finished.v1 and automation.run.failed.v1 once per failed run, delivered to the graph owner by the core notification definition of pkg/automation/engine/ownernotice (Contribute); outbox events gain a cause column. graph: the join and foreach outputs declare a branch's output and an item's value optional, so reading the results of a partial_failed foreach is no longer missing context.
